title: Trend Radar
subtitle: Discover what's trending across the platforms your audience lives on.

degraded.title: Some sources are temporarily unavailable
degraded.bannerBody: {count} of {total} sources are currently paused. Trends from the remaining sources are still live.

empty.title: No trends yet
empty.body: Once your sources sync, fresh signals appear here. Most sources run on a 6–24h cadence.

filters.title: Filters
filters.saveBody: Name this filter so you can apply it again later.
filters.name: Name

card.tosWarning: Unofficial source — ToS acknowledgement on file

onboarding.title: Pick your sources
onboarding.subtitle: Choose 4 or more sources to start. You can change these any time from the source settings page.
onboarding.error: Could not save your selection. Try again.
onboarding.adminOnly: Only agency admins can change the global source list. Contact them to add more.

forYou.title: Personalized for you
forYou.body: Once you've saved a few trends to boards and used them in briefs, the Fit score will learn what you actually publish and surface the highest-signal matches here.

boards.title: Boards
boards.body: Group trends into boards to plan campaigns, pitch ideas, and share with clients. Coming next sprint.

briefs.title: Closed-loop briefs
briefs.body: Briefs that started from a trend, with their published performance, will appear here once you create one with 'Use in brief'.

admin.title: Trend sources
admin.subtitle: Manage which sources the agency enables, configure API keys, and acknowledge ToS for grey-area tools.

settings.title: Trends settings
settings.subtitle: Opt out of specific sources and manage your trend data.
settings.optoutBody: Opt out of specific sources for this workspace without affecting the rest of the agency.
settings.optoutConfirmBody: Add a short reason. It will be saved to the audit log.

deleteData.title: Delete my trend data
deleteData.blurb: GDPR delete. Permanently delete every trend signal, board, brief, and feedback event for this workspace. Source enablement and audit logs are preserved.
deleteData.dialogTitle: Delete all trend data in this workspace
deleteData.dialogBody: This will permanently delete all your trend data in {name}. This cannot be undone.
deleteData.typedPhraseLabel: Type the workspace's name to confirm
deleteData.reasonHelp: At least 8 characters. Saved to the platform audit log alongside the per-table delete counts.
